research_candidate.input_order: URI76 unchanged, then 24 R23 path/query structure counts capped at 31 and divided by 31

warm_start.semantics: Copy parameters, zero 24 added input rows, initialize Adam state and global step from zero

proposed_optimization_if_readiness_passe.loss_mass: Use fit_cell_mass from the URI100 NPZ and binary_class_weights in the objective. Retain both labels in mixed groups and conserve mass from the parent URI76.
proposed_optimization_if_readiness_passe.checkpoint_selection: On approved grouped development only, prioritize transferred effective recall within request and vector FPR budgets, stability across components, then AP, then earlier checkpoint
proposed_optimization_if_readiness_passe.resume: Commit immutable checkpoint per completed epoch. Bind feature code, manifests, sampler seed/permutation, optimizer and config before resuming. Re-evaluate the selected epoch with independent calibration.

required_before_final_training_lock: Acquire a fresh component-disjoint development evaluation frame with source/label rights and trusted lineage. Compare URI100 and the frozen R20 at the same FP budgets without post-test threshold selection.
Require stability across independent groups and method/profile strata, including mixed components and POST support. The exposed WAF pilot does not establish a release threshold.
Register independent native CAL_FIT, CAL_OP and TEST_SHADOW according to T07, pin custody and no-overlap proofs before opening any protected evaluation artifacts.
required_before_release: After training and independent calibration, require T07 quality, the 90% recall project objective, adjusted FPR bound at most 1%, Python/ONNX and deployed Rust parity, cutoff availability, Local shadow and rollback before release.
